calvino_axiom: Falsehood is never in words; it is in things.
inner_arch: To explain Olivia's spirit and fortune, Marco Polo can ONLY speak of filigree palaces, fringed mullion cushions, a white peacock on a sprinklered lawn, supple white-leather saddlers, chattering raffia weavers, hanging mill-canals, and green nocturnal estuary canoes. Yet speaking truthfully in those exact graceful words inevitably discloses thick clouds of soot, grease crusts on house walls, trailers crushing pedestrians, sleepwalking outskirts, fixed-pace lathe mandrels, and sarcastic evening laughter—whereas attempting literal bleak speech flattens Olivia into a lifeless cliché unable to explain its prosperity. Words do not lie (`wordFalsehood === 0.0`); things themselves are double (`thingDuplicity -> 1.0`).

paired_stones.graceSpeech: Alabaster traceried mullions lined with saffron silk-fringed cushions catching the patio breeze.
paired_stones.thingDisclosure: Dense coal-and-oil soot rolling across skylights and choking the pierced stone apertures.

paired_stones.graceSpeech: Beyond the patio screen, whirling brass sprinklers mist an emerald lawn where a white peacock spreads its ocellated tail.
paired_stones.thingDisclosure: Viscous black tallow and machine-grease crusts coating masonry courses and staining white plumes.

paired_stones.graceSpeech: Fragrant saddleries stitching kid-supple cream-white harnesses, bridles, and gleaming brass buckles.
paired_stones.thingDisclosure: Articulated iron haulage trailers swinging wide in cramped alleys, pinning pedestrians flat against stone walls.

paired_stones.graceSpeech: Nimble women seated in a sunlit circle, chattering briskly while weaving geometric raffia rugs.
paired_stones.thingDisclosure: Exhausted shift-mouths cracking bitter, metallic jokes in the dark: falsehood is never in words, it is in things.

paired_stones.graceSpeech: Elevated stone aqueduct cascades turning timber-and-bronze overshot mill paddles above foam.
paired_stones.thingDisclosure: A thousand hands turning steel lathe mandrels at unrelenting shift paces driven by the same shafting.

paired_stones.graceSpeech: Breeze-brushed jade estuary at night lit by slow-stroked canoes carrying warm amber lanterns at the bow.
paired_stones.thingDisclosure: Somnambulist rows of blackened outskirts tenements and slag barges marching blindly between shifts.
